solution.title: Dynamic Device Targeting in Intune — Dynamic Groups & Filters

products.name: Dynamic Device Targeting in Intune — Dynamic Groups & Filters — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable dynamic device targeting model in Intune — dynamic security groups and assignment filters so policies and apps reach exactly the right devices automatically and stay correct as the fleet changes. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Target the right devices automatically — with dynamic groups and assignment filters, not manual lists

As a fleet grows, assigning policies and apps to hand-built static groups doesn't scale: new devices miss policy, membership drifts, and admins burn hours maintaining lists. The modern answer is dynamic targeting — dynamic security groups whose membership rules auto-include the right devices, and assignment filters that scope a single assignment to exactly the devices that match (OS, ownership, model, enrollment profile). This solution gives you a repeatable dynamic device targeting model in Intune so policies and apps reach the right devices automatically and stay correct as the fleet changes.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — dynamic security groups (membership rule syntax) vs. assignment filters (rule syntax + include/exclude at assignment time), when to use each, precedence and evaluation, and the scalable targeting model.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID with dynamic-group licensing, a device attribute/naming convention, enrollment profile names, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: define the targeting taxonomy, build dynamic security groups with membership rules, create assignment filters, apply filters to policy/app assignments, validate membership and effective targeting, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — dynamic-group/filter discovery, membership and effective-targeting validation, a targeting-coverage and drift report, safe remediation of mis-scoped assignments, and a dynamic-group/filter builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Policies and apps that reach exactly the right devices automatically — dynamic groups and assignment filters replacing hand-maintained static lists, staying correct as the fleet changes — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • DYNTGT-Discovery.ps1 — inventory dynamic security groups and assignment filters (Microsoft Graph)
    • DYNTGT-Remediation.ps1 — safely attach the intended assignment filter to a mis-scoped assignment
    • DYNTGT-Report.ps1 — targeting coverage and drift across the fleet (Microsoft Graph)
    • DYNTGT-Set-DynamicGroupFilter.ps1 — create a dynamic security group and/or an assignment filter
    • DYNTGT-Validation.ps1 — validate a device's dynamic group membership and effective targeting

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
